_what: Settings for a screen shown alone in its page (src/workspace/alone-page.tsx): the screen a row marks `shown_alone` fills the page with no sidebar and no arrangement, for a host app's small window (the Mac app's menu bar panel). `host_channel` is the name of the message channel a host app listens on (window.webkit.messageHandlers.<name>); a page with no such channel tells nobody. `host_reach` is the name on window the host calls the page by (alone-page.tsx invariant 4), and the name the Mac panel probes to know the page started (macos/App/MenuBarPanel.swift keepPageAlive). `words` are every word the page itself shows (the shortcut row's words are src/workspace/panel-shortcut.tsx's, the menu bar item's rows' (`menubar` and `settings`, by the host's row id) are src/workspace/panel-settings.tsx's, the Set up this Mac section's are src/workspace/panel-setup.tsx's).

host_kinds._what: The message kinds that cross the host channel. to_host: posted by the page through window.webkit.messageHandlers[host_channel] (size, glance, outside: alone-page.tsx invariant 3; notify and register_device: alone-notices.mjs). from_host: sent by the host through the host(message) entry of alone-page.tsx invariant 4 (notice_tapped: alone-notices.mjs).

notices._what: The notices loop of this page (alone-notices.mjs): how often the device reads its notices again, and how many it reads at once.

words.missing: This screen is not here any more

words.setup_note: What Trillion keeps set up on this Mac, one step at a time. Each can be taken back.
